Since then, 20+ people have been using the device, some for 17+ hours per day.

Decoding the full virtual arm . This requires deciphering 29 degrees of freedom against millisecond timescale neural spikes. We aim to fully decipher human intent of controlling anything that a human hand is capable of doing, and build a product that our users rely on for their independence every day.
Brain to voice . The frontier of real-time voice synthesis from intracortical signals is intelligible roughly half the time and carries only coarse pitch control (Wairagkar et al., Nature , 2025).
